name: AirFanta 3Pro
summary: A cube of four PC fans and HEPA panels that cleans far more air per dollar and per decibel than any conventional purifier here. Three independent testers confirm the numbers. It has no app, sensor or auto mode, it looks industrial, and the small brand gives only an email address for support.
idealFor: Studios over 400 sq ft, or wildfire smoke
Buyers who care about clean air per dollar more than looks
pros: Most cleaning at quiet speeds here: 213 cfm under 45 dBA (HouseFresh)
Cleared HouseFresh's test room in 17 minutes at top speed
Packs flat for moving or travel
cons: No app, sensor, auto mode or filter reminder
Industrial look; one reviewer found assembly fiddly
Support by email only; no postal address published
Out of stock at AirFanta's US store when we checked

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it delivers unusually high CADR for the price, and their measurements back AirFanta's rating. It loses most points on accountability: the website gives an email but no postal address, its US trademark filing from 2024 has no confirmed registration, and the 1-year warranty has no published terms. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list.

sources.title: HouseFresh: AirFanta 3Pro review
sources.note: Danny Ashton, Sept 2024 (updated Oct 2026), bought with own money. PM1 CADR 353 cfm at top, 213 under 45 dBA; test room cleared in 17 min; 36.1–56.3 dBA at 3 ft; 12.6 in cube, 7.7 lb; cites independent CADR tests of 413 cfm at 12 V
